integrity: The complete 16x16 incidence matrix and 11 finite 16x32 integer presentations are constructed in an included executable verifier using exact integer Smith normal form.
scientific_limitations: Odd characteristic and smooth genus-two Jacobians only; classical Kummer geometry is preexisting. This is an integral incidence and finite Galois coinvariant statement, not a Picard or Brauer result. An equivalent older design-theory Smith/cyclic-coinvariant table could exist; no absolute priority certification.
title: Arithmetic coinvariants of the Kummer node--trope incidence correspondence
